_about: The two Plinys in English, translator per title. Elder: John Bostock and H. T. Riley's Natural History (Bohn, 1855-57), 6 vols., clean Gutenberg. Younger: William Melmoth's Letters (1746), revised by F. C. T. Bosanquet; John B. Firth's Letters, First Series vol. 1. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).
